ui.setupHelp:
1. In CIPP open **CIPP** in the sidebar, then **Integrations > CIPP-API**.
2. **Actions > Create New Client**, name it `conduit-mcp`. Leave **MCP Access Allowed** off, that converts the client into the MCP resource app and it stops working as a normal API client. Optionally set a read-only custom role and allowed IP ranges.
3. Enable the client, submit, copy the application secret.
4. **Actions > Save Azure Configuration** to push the client into the function app's auth settings.
5. Fields below: Base URL is your CIPP instance URL, Client ID and Tenant ID as shown on the CIPP-API page.

settings.label: Base URL
settings.help: Your CIPP instance URL, e.g. https://cipp.yourdomain.com

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration used for the CIPP API

settings.label: Client secret
settings.help: Client secret of the same app registration

settings.label: Tenant ID
settings.help: Directory (tenant) ID of the Entra tenant hosting CIPP
